method.scope: Every ready transient recipe and native activity/use variant; persistent catalogs checked separately. Automated timing/pose scan, not a claim of manual review of every description.
method.reviewed: Complete descriptions re-read for the explicitly listed movement replacements. Physical ranged releases additionally use the existing description-derived weapon/motif and actual source-origin flight.
method.runtime: Pure pose sampling and existing mocked runtime regressions; design preview browser checks recorded in the companion document. Live Foundry multiplayer was not exercised this pass.
